messages.author: 9fd9c6688f1836e4
messages.subject: CFA Warning messages
parts:
Hello, I'm running CFA in R using matrix correlation.
lavaan indicates that lavaan 0.6.13 ended normally after 272 iterations
with SRMR=0.1, RMSEA=0.23, CFI=0.989, TLI=0.899, df=28, R2=2042.937

I got the following warning message when I run the CFA:

fit.cfaMod<-cfa(cfaMod,sample.cov=d,sample.nobs=1193, estimator = "ML")
Warning messages:
1: In lav_model_vcov(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavsamplestats = lavsamplestats,  :
  lavaan WARNING:
    Could not compute standard errors! The information matrix could
    not be inverted. This may be a symptom that the model is not
    identified.
2: In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: covariance matrix of latent variables
                is not positive definite;
                use lavInspect(fit, "cov.lv") to investigate.
3: In lav_object_post_check(object) :
  lavaan WARNING: the covariance matrix of the residuals of the observed
                variables (theta) is not positive definite;
                use lavInspect(fit, "theta") to investigate.

This my code.
Any help will be very helpfull to solve this warning message.

setwd("~/My topic/My topic/DATA/VALID DATA/Data_final")
Mal<-read.csv("CC_Malarias.csv",header = TRUE,sep = ",")
str('Mal')
head(Mal)
names(Mal)
attach(Mal)
summary(is.na(Mal))
str(Mal)
#### Convert to numerical#############
Mal$Min_Relative.Humidity<-as.numeric(as.factor(Mal$Min_Relative.Humidity))
Mal$Max_Relative.Humidity<-as.numeric(as.factor(Mal$Max_Relative.Humidity))#######
str(Mal)
d<-cor.smooth(Mal,eig.tol = 10^-4)### Smooth the matrix(non positive)

cfaMod<-'F3=~Rainfall+Min_Relative.Humidity+Max_Temperature
F1=~Mean_Relative.Humidity+Max_Relative.Humidity
F2=~Mean_Temperature+Min_Temperature
Malaria_Incidence~F1+F2+F3
Rainfall~~Max_Temperature+Min_Relative.Humidity+Mean_Relative.Humidity
+Max_Relative.Humidity
Mean_Temperature~~Max_Temperature+Min_Temperature
Max_Temperature~~Min_Relative.Humidity+Max_Relative.Humidity+Mean_Relative.Humidity
Mean_Relative.Humidity~~Min_Relative.Humidity+Max_Relative.Humidity
Min_Relative.Humidity~~Max_Relative.Humidity
F1~~F3
F1~~F1
F2~~F2
F3~~F3'

fit.cfaMod<-cfa(cfaMod,sample.cov =d,sample.nobs=1193, estimator = "ML")
summary(fit.cfaMod,fit.measures=TRUE,standardized=TRUE,rsq=TRUE)

messages.author: ac9e1459001ea58d
messages.subject: Re: CFA Warning messages
parts:
Hiya, 

Can you try to fit the model using only the first 4 lines? (Definition of F1, F2 and F3 factors and the malaria regression.) Most of the covariances you have below those lines will be added automatically.

Also, because you have a couple of regressions in there I'd use the `sem` function instead of the `cfa` function -- they're mostly interchangeable but they set a couple of defaults that may be helpful.

Best, 
Stijn
